text: EX-99.1 3 d180521dex991.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 StubHub Announces Extension of Senior Credit Facilities Extends US Dollar and Euro Term Loan B Maturities to October 2033 and Revolving Credit Facility to October 2031 Reduces Borrowing Costs on Term Loans by 25 Basis Points Strengthens Foreign Exchange Risk Profile NEW YORK, NY – October 14, 2026 – StubHub Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: STUB), a leading global ticketing marketplace for live events, today announced it has extended the maturities of its senior credit facilities, further strengthening the company’s balance sheet and extending its capital structure runway. StubHub, through its wholly owned subsidiary StubHub Holdco Sub, LLC, amended its existing credit agreement to extend the maturity of its $804 million USD Term Loan B and its €452 million Euro Term Loan B (collectively, the “Term Loans”) by 3.5 years from March 2030 to October 2033. As part of the transaction, the company increased the USD Term Loan B by $171 million and reduced the Euro Term Loan B by €152 million, thereby strengthening its foreign exchange risk profile. As a result, the amended credit agreement now consists of a $975 million USD Term Loan B and a €300 million Euro Term Loan B. The total amount under the Term Loans remains unchanged. The transaction brought a 25-basis point improvement in borrowing costs with the extended USD Term Loan B bearing interest at SOFR plus 450 basis points and the extended Euro Term Loan B bearing interest at EURIBOR plus 475 basis points. The company also extended the maturity of a portion of its existing Revolving Credit Facility by one year from September 2030 to October 2031, subject to the terms of the amendment. The transaction follows a period of significant deleveraging for StubHub since its September 2025 initial public offering. The company has repaid $1.1 billion of debt over the prior twelve months. In September, Moody’s Ratings upgraded the Corporate Family Rating of StubHub to B2 from B3. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. served as Lead Left Arranger and Administrative Agent on the transaction. About StubHub StubHub is a leading global ticketing marketplace for live events. Through StubHub and its international brand viagogo, the company services customers in over 200 countries and territories, supporting over 30 languages and accepting payments in over 45 currencies – from sports to music, comedy to dance, festivals to theater. StubHub offers a safe and convenient way to buy or sell tickets to live events across the world for memorable live experiences.
